name: Baxi Chong

fitReason: Officially dated recent AP with a concrete PPO-to-hardware anchor and a current independent multi-legged robotics group. Fit is embodied locomotion and morphology/control interaction, rather than conversational HRI or foundation-model manipulation.

physicalEvidence.summary: A 2024 coauthored preprint trains PPO in MuJoCo to adjust three gait-wave amplitudes from foot-contact feedback. Its results separate simulation from physical rough-terrain and five outdoor tests. Execution is verified at the prior Georgia Tech collaboration; current Penn State learned-hardware access is not independently established.
